title: Redis Pattern Plan
description: A structured plan for a Redis caching/locking/queueing design, so this skill's anti-patterns and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/redis_patterns_audit.mjs.

useCase.description: The primary Redis pattern this plan implements, per the When-to-use list in SKILL.md.

messagingPrimitive.description: For durable-queue/notification use cases: the delivery primitive. Streams = at-least-once durable; pub/sub = at-most-once ephemeral.

ttlSet.description: True if every cache key is written with a TTL.

ttlJitter.description: True if cache TTLs include 5-15% randomization to prevent synchronized expiry dogpiles.

atomicSetWithExpiry.description: True if TTLs are set atomically (SET key val EX seconds), never SET followed by EXPIRE.

lockOwnershipToken.description: True if the distributed lock stores a per-acquisition random token so only the owner can release it.

lockReleaseViaLua.description: True if lock release is a compare-and-delete Lua script (atomic), not separate GET + DEL.

pendingReclaimHandled.description: True if Streams consumers reclaim idle PEL entries from crashed peers (XPENDING + XCLAIM / XAUTOCLAIM) with a dead-letter threshold.

streamMaxlenCapped.description: True if stream growth is capped with XADD ... MAXLEN ~ N.

usesKeysCommand.description: True if any production code path issues the KEYS command (a blocking full scan).

largeDeleteMethod.description: How structures with thousands+ of items are deleted.

maxmemorySet.description: True if maxmemory and maxmemory-policy are set explicitly for the target environment.
